name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 7 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 7 hours starting 2026-05-18, at wavelengths from 1.01 to 4.69 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
